Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified the release year of the Icehouse game system as 1998. In the conversation history, during the analysis of the WebSurfer's results (which found an "initial test run" in December 1989 on BoardGameGeek), the Planner explicitly stated: "WebSurfer found the BoardGameGeek Icehouse page, which confirms Icehouse originated around 1998 (initial test run in December 1998)." This is a factual error; the source data clearly showed December 1989. This incorrect year (1998) was then carried forward in subsequent steps, leading the team to believe Icehouse was released after Kill Doctor Lucky (1996) initially, or causing confusion until the final step where the correct 1989 date was finally recognized but the damage to the reasoning process had already occurred. The Planner's failure to correctly extract "1989" from the text "December 1989" and instead hallucinating or misreading it as 1998 was the root cause of the error.
